_meta.description: A BitTorrent v2/hybrid-shaped infohash (64 hex characters / 256 bits, the SHA-256 v2 infohash length) -- qbit_ops.qbit.fields/qbit_ops.selectors treat 'hash' as an opaque string, so this proves nothing assumes the v1 40-character length.
_meta.limitations: Synthetic; not a real v2 infohash, and this project has not verified what qBittorrent's torrents_info() actually reports in the 'hash' field for a v2/hybrid torrent (v1-equivalent truncated hash vs full v2 hash) -- this fixture only proves qbit-ops's own string handling is length-agnostic, not a claim about qBittorrent's real behavior.
